name: march_in_place
text: A person marches in place with alternating high knees. Lift the left knee, set the left foot down in its original spot, then lift the right knee and set it down. Repeat several times with opposite arm swing. Remain in the same location facing forward, do not travel.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 原地交替高抬腿并对侧摆臂，取试片40至94帧包含两次左右踏步的完整段，重生成后取中间周期。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
